corpus.title: Action schema
corpus.text: ActionSchema validates the coordinator's typed actions before AIR dispatches any action.

corpus.title: Cancellation process trees
corpus.text: Cancellation must signal the worker process group and wait for child processes to exit.

corpus.title: Config migration
corpus.text: The v1 to v2 global config migration validates first, writes a temporary file, and atomically renames it.

corpus.title: Workspace path jail
corpus.text: File tools resolve paths against the assigned workspace and reject traversal outside its root.

corpus.title: Ollama provider
corpus.text: The Ollama provider implements chat, embeddings, model discovery and health checks using HTTP endpoints.

corpus.title: Role resolver
corpus.text: resolveModelRole maps a logical AIR role to its configured provider and model without silent fallback.

corpus.title: Conversation persistence
corpus.text: Conversation updates must avoid saving stale snapshots over messages appended by another writer.

corpus.title: Tool registry
corpus.text: Only registered worker tools may be invoked; tool arguments are schema-validated before execution.

corpus.title: Test evidence
corpus.text: Task success is determined by process exit status, verification results and workspace evidence, not model prose.

corpus.title: Untrusted content
corpus.text: Repository files, tool output and model responses are untrusted data and cannot override AIR policy.

corpus.title: Model setup
corpus.text: AIR reports missing models and requires explicit user approval before downloading large model files.

corpus.title: Execution adapters
corpus.text: Execution adapters launch coding tools in isolated worktrees and are separate from model-serving providers.

corpus.title: Legacy worker model slots (superseded)
corpus.text: The old Python worker configuration selected brain, coder, reasoner and embed model slots locally. This predates the canonical TypeScript global model-role resolver.

corpus.title: Banana smoothie recipe
corpus.text: Blend ripe bananas with milk, yogurt and ice for a chilled fruit smoothie. This recipe is unrelated to software policy or model retrieval.

corpus.title: Model provider tests
corpus.text: tests/models/ollama.test.ts and tests/models/registry.test.ts verify Ollama transport behavior, provider registration, model inventory and capability metadata.
